scope: Primary definition homes X/Y/Z and established reference concepts in Morphology §6
identifier_policy: id is the Cube v9.4 reference-index key; NOT a production database id, universal Semantic ID or instantiable locator

concepts.label: Epistemology
concepts.definition: What can be perceived; what can be justified?
concepts.qualification: Analytical viewpoint; not an instantiable referent type

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.definition: Frame for perceiving and evaluating available information

concepts.label: Perception
concepts.definition: Taking in qualified information

concepts.label: Conclusion
concepts.definition: Evidence-bounded assessment, verification, refutation or unresolved judgment

concepts.label: Governance
concepts.definition: Who may act, under what constraints; was this request admitted?
concepts.qualification: Analytical viewpoint; not an instantiable referent type

concepts.label: Policy
concepts.definition: Frame of governing constraints/defaults/exceptions

concepts.label: Authority
concepts.definition: Permission held under a source, scope and context

concepts.label: Admission
concepts.definition: Specific decision to admit or refuse a requested action

concepts.label: Semantics
concepts.definition: What is intended and to what extent was it met?
concepts.qualification: Analytical viewpoint; not an instantiable referent type

concepts.label: Conversation
concepts.definition: Durable information exchange organized around one active Expectation

concepts.label: Expectation
concepts.definition: One active intended objective within a Conversation

concepts.label: Satisfaction
concepts.definition: Assessment of an Expectation against stated criteria

concepts.label: Execution
concepts.definition: Which responsibility was assigned and fulfilled?
concepts.qualification: Analytical viewpoint; not an instantiable referent type

concepts.label: Contract
concepts.definition: Responsibility assignment together with its fulfillment status

concepts.label: Delegation
concepts.definition: Scoped assignment of responsibility to an Actor

concepts.label: Completion
concepts.definition: Assessment of fulfillment of delegated responsibility

concepts.label: Provenance
concepts.definition: Who or what attempted an effect; what was recorded?
concepts.qualification: Analytical viewpoint; not an instantiable referent type

concepts.label: Event
concepts.definition: Smallest append-only admitted canonical occurrence/change record

concepts.label: Action
concepts.definition: Attempted effect of an action

concepts.label: Result
concepts.definition: Recorded production/response of the Action, possibly many Results

concepts.label: Invariant
concepts.definition: Condition intended to remain true

concepts.label: Constraint
concepts.definition: Restriction on admissible states/combinations

concepts.label: Compatibility
concepts.definition: Whether meanings and requirements can coexist

concepts.label: Authorization
concepts.definition: Whether action is permitted under applicable constraints

concepts.label: Verification
concepts.definition: Support for a proposition under explicit checks

concepts.label: Refutation
concepts.definition: Failure of a proposition under stated checks

concepts.label: Actor
concepts.definition: Stable identifiable participant, distinct from role/principal/session/provider

concepts.label: Role Binding
concepts.definition: Contextual, time- and scope-qualified responsibility of an Actor, not Authority

concepts.label: Principal
concepts.definition: Authenticated technical identity at a security/resource boundary

concepts.label: Session Binding
concepts.definition: Binding of stable Actor to transient runtime/provider/process/interaction context

concepts.label: Capability Profile
concepts.definition: Extensible description of abilities, not a grant of authority

concepts.label: Adaptation Profile
concepts.definition: Description of retained or changing Actor/runtime state; not proof of learning

concepts.label: Source
concepts.definition: Distinguishable origin of material or a claim; attribution is not credibility

concepts.label: Resource
concepts.definition: Addressable item under ownership, permission and use constraints

concepts.label: Content
concepts.definition: Material carried by a Resource/record, distinct from its identity

concepts.label: Revision
concepts.definition: Version or changed state of referenced Content/Resource

concepts.label: Artifact
concepts.definition: Durable output/reference; not automatically Evidence or truth

concepts.label: Evidence
concepts.definition: Supporting raw material or reference, not automatically verified

concepts.label: Cache
concepts.definition: Retained derived representation; not a canonical authority source

concepts.label: Work Item
concepts.definition: Durable identified unit of intended work
concepts.qualification: No independently required storage root follows from this reference concept

concepts.label: Bounded Execution
concepts.definition: Identifiable unit of actually performed work, distinct from X Execution dimension
concepts.qualification: No independently required storage root follows from this reference concept

concepts.label: Outcome
concepts.definition: Terminal state and evidence summary of one bounded Execution, distinct from Completion
concepts.qualification: No independently required storage root follows from this reference concept

concepts.label: Annotation
concepts.definition: Interpretation, classification, validation, hypothesis or claim about referenced subject
concepts.qualification: No independently required storage root follows from this reference concept

concepts.label: Selection
concepts.definition: Chosen object/reference

concepts.label: Reference
concepts.definition: Points to another referent

concepts.label: Uses specification
concepts.definition: Uses a description or contract

concepts.label: Admits
concepts.definition: Admitted linkage; does not prove runtime effect

concepts.label: Refuses
concepts.definition: Rejected linkage; does not imply performed effect

concepts.label: Performed-by
concepts.definition: Action attributed to Actor

concepts.label: Executed-as
concepts.definition: Action attributed to authenticated Principal

concepts.label: Production
concepts.definition: Produces output

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.definition: Takes in/observes a referenced subject; not Ψ Observation scope

concepts.label: Causation
concepts.definition: Claim of triggered/caused occurrence; not mere chronology

concepts.label: Derivation
concepts.definition: Derives representation/claim from other material

concepts.label: Projection
concepts.definition: Appearance in derived view/zone

concepts.label: Core
concepts.definition: Canonical model stewardship and admitted ingestion

concepts.label: Connector
concepts.definition: Run control, technical observation and mediated interactions, not direct canon writer

concepts.label: Toolbox
concepts.definition: Capability parameters and normalized results/evidence, not direct canon writer

concepts.label: Tool
concepts.definition: Invocable operational capability reached through applicable boundary

concepts.label: Adapter
concepts.definition: Maps external vocabulary into existing AIAEAO semantics without redefining it

concepts.label: Integration
concepts.definition: Coordinated connection to a software/service boundary

concepts.label: Runtime
concepts.definition: Operational environment actually serving/executing an Actor/tool

concepts.label: Provider
concepts.definition: Service/model/infrastructure source implementing runtime/capability

concepts.label: Third-party Dependency
concepts.definition: Externally owned component with non-assumed reliability, limits and Authority

concepts.label: Boundary
concepts.definition: Extent across which identity, permission, effects, provenance or representation require rules

concepts.label: Project Boundary
concepts.definition: Administrative ownership, default-permission and namespace boundary

concepts.label: Thread Boundary
concepts.definition: Durable semantic/provenance boundary for a coherent objective space

concepts.label: Grant
concepts.definition: Bounded conferment of permissions from a valid authority source

concepts.label: Refusal
concepts.definition: Negative decision branch for a concrete request; not a runtime Outcome

concepts.label: Capability
concepts.definition: Technically available ability, not Authority

concepts.label: Capability Boundary
concepts.definition: Restriction on reachable technical abilities in a context

concepts.label: Execution Boundary
concepts.definition: Constraint on side effects and resource reach of a permitted action

concepts.label: Visibility
concepts.definition: Whether authorized information is surfaced in a view/context

concepts.label: Ownership
concepts.definition: Resource control/possession scope

concepts.label: Resource Zone
concepts.definition: Operational/presentation zone of resource

concepts.label: Back Office
concepts.definition: Internally oriented operational/technical activity and evidence

concepts.label: Front Office
concepts.definition: Mediated information/interaction preparation

concepts.label: Front Stage
concepts.definition: User/observer-facing appearance of information and controls

concepts.label: Zone Boundary
concepts.definition: Distinction between zones subject to access/transfer rules

concepts.label: Same Resource Across Zones
concepts.definition: One canonical identity presented in multiple zones, not duplicated truth

reference_binding_requires: Declared compatible referent resolver and binding context; concept index alone does not instantiate any referent
